name: Gide Roots
statusLabel: Coming soon to Android and iOS
headline: Grow the story of where you come from.
lede: Build a beautiful, private family tree that connects the people in Gide Legacy and preserves the structure of your family for generations.
heroNote: No account required · Works offline · Your data stays yours
sectionHeading: More than names on a chart.
sectionBody: Roots gives you four thoughtful ways to see your family, plus simple tools to build, organize, move, and preserve your history.

features.title: Living family tree
features.body: Explore your family in a distinctive, rotating tree view that makes every branch feel alive.

features.title: Clear family chart
features.body: See generations, parents, children, and spouses in a familiar chart you can pan and zoom.

features.title: Heirloom parchment
features.body: Turn family connections into a warm, keepsake-style pedigree inspired by aged paper and ink.

features.title: People at a glance
features.body: Keep names, dates, places, portraits, and relationships organized in one sortable list.

features.title: GEDCOM compatible
features.body: Import an existing genealogy file or export your tree in the widely used GEDCOM format.

features.title: Private by design
features.body: No account, no cloud, and no Google sign-in. Your family information stays on your device.

privacy.heading: Your tree belongs to you.
privacy.body: Roots works without an account or cloud service. Your family information is stored locally on your device, and you decide when to import, export, or share it.

points.title: No tracking
points.body: Roots does not collect or sell your family information.

points.title: No connection required
points.body: Build and explore your tree while offline.

points.title: You stay in control
points.body: Move your own data with roster and GEDCOM tools.

companion.eyebrow: Better together, strong on their own
companion.heading: The companion app to Gide Legacy.
companion.body: Roots organizes the people and relationships in your family. Gide Legacy preserves the memories and media that bring those people to life. Roots works fully on its own, and the two apps are designed to share one family roster when used together.

faq.q: Can I import an existing family tree?
faq.a: Yes. Roots supports GEDCOM import and export for compatible genealogy tools.
